explication: RD-Agent is a framework for autonomous research and development across data science, quantitative finance, Kaggle, LLM fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning. Its user-facing workflow is to launch a scenario, iterate on research proposals and generated experiments, execute and evaluate them, and inspect the run trace. The tree shows distinct scenario and coder modules alongside shared agent, workflow, and logging layers. The sampled source chiefly verifies trace storage and web-server interactions, so most internal workflow wiring is intentionally left unspecified.
